content: Human-labeling session — economy-time-box:easy seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a fixed-budget time-boxed buildup. You start with a Construction Yard, one Power Plant, and an Allied Barracks, plus $4000 cash. Within about 56 turns, you must grow your standing base to at least 4 buildings (any additional production or storage building — a 2nd power plant, a silo, an Ore Refinery, etc. — adds to the count) AND have at least 4 units in the field. Idle cash is wasted; spending it all on units leaves only 3 buildings; spending it all on buildings leaves 0 units. The clock bites — sit on the budget and you LOSE.
